lawyer: Shaheed Alam, Advocate ------- For the Petitioner.
parties:
Abdul Jabbar ------- Petitioner
Vs.
1. The State 2. Pradip Kumar Biswas ------- Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 5. In the Rule issued by this Court the Rule was made returnable within four weeks which does not mean that the stay granted was for four weeks only. A returnable rule is dated on which the service of notices upon the parties are said to be notified fixing that date for the appearance of the opposite parties. It is not a limitation of the stay as granted by this court. That being the position and having considered that the Court below did not carefully read and in fact misread the said order granted by this Court, we are not inclined to issue a Rule but we direct that the Court must not take any further steps as further proceeding has already been stayed in that criminal matter till hearing of the Criminal Revision being No. 927/1990.
